caption: The drawing depicts a single handheld bellows, centrally positioned against a plain, off-white background. The bellows has two flat, straight wooden handles at the top, colored in a natural brown wood tone. The body of the bellows is primarily oval, also in a wood grain brown, featuring concentric circular carvings on its surface. The side portion of the bellows is constructed of reddish material that appears to be leather, bordered by a dark trim. The bottom of the bellows tapers into a conical black metal nozzle, which is attached with decorative wrappings including a strip of deep red, a section of blue with lighter circular dots, and a small area of green. Below the bellows, the name "Oscar Bluhme" is lightly written in thin, black capital letters. The composition is simple, focusing solely on the bellows with no additional objects or background elements.
title: Bellows
